CustomField.description: Used to identify if the POC is created for an Account where the country is restricted and there is no country exception ISR. 09/07/2020: Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Philippines have been made unrestricted. NH Only visible to admin
CustomField.formula:
(ISPICKVAL(Deployment_Country__c, "Bahrain") || ISPICKVAL(Deployment_Country__c, "Bulgaria") || ISPICKVAL(Deployment_Country__c, "Chile") || ISPICKVAL(Deployment_Country__c, "Czech Republic") || ISPICKVAL(Deployment_Country__c, "Estonia") || ISPICKVAL(Deployment_Country__c, "Kuwait") || ISPICKVAL(Deployment_Country__c, "Latvia") || ISPICKVAL(Deployment_Country__c, "Lithuania") || ISPICKVAL(Deployment_Country__c, "Mexico") || ISPICKVAL(Deployment_Country__c, "Oman") || ISPICKVAL(Deployment_Country__c, "Qatar") || ISPICKVAL(Deployment_Country__c, "Romania") || ISPICKVAL(Deployment_Country__c, "Saudi Arabia") || ISPICKVAL(Deployment_Country__c, "United Arab Emirates"))
&&
(Account__r.Country_Exception_Approved__c = FALSE || (Account__r.Country_Exception_Approved__c = TRUE && TEXT( Account__r.HQ_Country__c) != TEXT(Deployment_Country__c)))
CustomField.label: Unapproved Country
